propositions.statement: For an online ticketing/event-management platform with Linux servers and containers, build a forensic triage tool to turn diverse logs into reliable, reviewable leads about failed logins and suspected shell injection.

propositions.statement: Support reconstruction of what happened, when, targeted systems, and which actual log records warrant human investigation; do not assume two suspicious activities are related or an attack succeeded.

propositions.statement: Investigate SSH authentication, reverse-proxy HTTP access and application/container console log evidence with varying formats, timestamps, duplicate lines, truncated/malformed lines.
propositions.scope_note: source-aware triage; no attribution/execution claims

propositions.statement: Do not declare a breach, successful exploitation or compromised system merely from suspicious strings.
propositions.scope_note: source-aware triage; no attribution/execution claims
